title: plugin-list, plugin-map, plugin-timeline: the record preview overlay is a raw Object.entries dump in four views while five views render RecordDetailPanel — plus four byte-identical helpers to collapse
body:
Filing gate ③: a maintainer-directed task. Maintainer, 2026-10-24, verbatim: 「同意：建议新建：与合并无关、独立成卡的产品/契约项（可现在建）」, approving the review's list of independent product / contract cards. Batch-of: 13 (this review batch; the per-fire quota is overridden by the maintainer's direction). Also filing gate ①: a user-visible defect with a named location. reach: the record preview overlay opened from a row in the list, gallery, map and timeline views (interface entry; files named below).

## 维护者速读

同一条记录，从列表/画廊/地图/时间线四个视图点开的预览弹层是 `Object.entries(record)` 的原始键值 dump（snake_case 键、`String(value)`），而日历/甘特/网格/看板/树五个视图用 `RecordDetailPanel`。四处弹层体 15 行逐字节相同。顺带四组已漂移的复制：`GANTT_CONFIG_SPELLING` 两份、记录可编辑判定缓存两份（分别引 #11699 与 #13341）、`isSameAuthoredFilter` 两份、`isPlainObject`/`isRecord` 33 个定义（其中一处接受数组）、`formatDate` 三份。

## Measured (2026-10-24, HEAD 7981384; duplicate detection over normalised consecutive lines, blocks of 8 or more identical lines across packages)

- Raw-dump overlay body (`Object.entries(record).map(([key, value]) => … key.replace(/_/g, ' ') … String(value ?? '—')`) inside `NavigationOverlay` is byte-identical in `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`, `packages/plugin-list/src/ObjectGallery.tsx`, `packages/plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx`, `packages/plugin-timeline/src/ObjectTimeline.tsx`. `grep -rl "<RecordDetailPanel" packages/plugin-*/src` → calendar, gantt, grid, kanban, tree (and plugin-detail itself).
- `const GANTT_CONFIG_SPELLING` (33 lines) defined twice: `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` and `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx`.
- Verdict cache (`cachedPrincipal` / `retainForPrincipal` / `verdictCache` / `pendingVerdicts` / `recheckDue`) copied between `packages/plugin-detail/src/useRecordEditable.ts` and `packages/plugin-grid/src/hooks/useRecordCrudVerdicts.ts`; the two copies already cite different issues (objectui#11699 vs objectui#13341). plugin-grid already depends on plugin-detail.
- `isSameAuthoredFilter` (23 lines) identical in `packages/react/src/hooks/useResolvedFilter.ts` and `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`; ObjectGrid already imports 13 names from `@object-ui/react`.
- `isPlainObject` / `isRecord` / `isObject`: 33 definitions in 10 packages; one variant (`react/src/hooks/useElementDataSource.ts`) omits the `!Array.isArray` check. `formatDate(s, locale)` byte-identical in `apps/console/src/pages/system/AuditLogPage.tsx`, `apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordApprovalsPanel.tsx` while `@object-ui/i18n` exports `formatDate` / `formatDateTime`. Positive control: `cn` has exactly one definition.
- Business reason: a business user who previews the same record from the map and from the kanban sees two different panels; AI-written fixes to the verdict cache land in one copy and miss the other (already happened: the two copies cite different cards).
- Dedup (`Object.entries(record)|RecordDetailPanel|GANTT_CONFIG_SPELLING|isPlainObject|formatDate`): 10 hits, 0 open, none about the overlay inconsistency or the copies (objectui#11672 was a closed dogfood sweep; objectui#6349 covered duplicate type names, not code).

## Task

- [ ] Render `RecordDetailPanel` from `@object-ui/plugin-detail` in the list, gallery, map and timeline overlays (the same plugin-to-plugin-detail edge five plugins already carry).
- [ ] One `GANTT_CONFIG_SPELLING` exported from the package that owns the lower layer; one verdict cache in plugin-detail consumed by plugin-grid; `isSameAuthoredFilter` exported from `react`.
- [ ] Add `isPlainObject` to `@object-ui/core` (beside `deepFreeze`) and replace the 33 locals when a file is touched; collapse the three `formatDate` copies onto `@object-ui/i18n`'s `formatDateTime` now. No lint rule.

Who acts: objectui `domain:ui` seat; the overlay fix is one PR, the helper collapses can ride it or follow. Effort S. Risk low.

Filed by the read-only whole-repo review session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01BDtwYUWhLGyWLzYQjZ95Cf` on 2026-10-24, written through the maintainer's own account token (the session holds no fleet-bot credential). Evidence files: that session's scratchpad (`objectui-review-report.md`, `findings-*.md`). ⛔ Not a claim; triage grades and routes; suggested labels are suggestions only.
